migration_blocker_detail: The migration function code uses the Supabase PostgreSQL pooler over IPv4 (reachable from any Netlify Lambda region). It requires DATABASE_PASSWORD env var — the actual PostgreSQL database password issued by Supabase, NOT the service-role JWT. No such credential is currently provisioned. An external operator must set DATABASE_PASSWORD in the Netlify production env, then re-invoke the migration endpoint to apply supabase/migrations/20260811100000_customer_auth_and_chat.sql. Until then the customer-auth UI surfaces a 'not connected' state and the live database has no customer_auth tables. All other product surfaces (anonymous chat, anonymous audit, owner CRM, public marketing, global navigation, security fix from ee9b339) are operational on Deploy #2.
